verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents dedicated support for HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS, plus CMMC and NIST 800-171, alongside SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Its frameworks page states that each supported framework gets control mapping and automated control testing within the same platform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use, and deeper documentation of per-framework coverage (GDPR and HIPAA evidence is marketing-level), including how controls are reused across frameworks.

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool

citations.quote: Secureframe makes it easy to set up your HIPAA policies.
Connect your cloud services to automatically check if you are configured for GDPR.
Secureframe streamlines the PCI DSS certification process at every step
Each supported framework includes control mapping to framework requirements, automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies
